title: Detecting a Non-Conservative Vector Field
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Show that F = <y, 2x> is not conservative.
finalAnswer: \frac{\partial N}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial M}{\partial y} = 1 \ne 0 \implies \mathbf{F} \text{ is not conservative}

steps.title: Compute Partial Cross Derivatives
steps.mathExpression: M = y \implies \frac{\partial M}{\partial y} = 1; \quad N = 2x \implies \frac{\partial N}{\partial x} = 2
steps.explanation: Differentiate M with respect to y and N with respect to x.

steps.title: Compare Values
steps.explanation: Since the mixed partials are not equal, F cannot be the gradient of any scalar potential.
